To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel, intelligent, inexpensive, scalable, and accurate solution for identifying and characterizing real time video traffic.
We develop a fully functioning softwarized network monitoring middle box for identifying and classifing video traffic in real time.

iTeleScope is an intelligent, inexpensive, scalable, softwarized network monitoring solution for identifying and characterizing video flows in real time, that achieves over 95% classification accuracy, that is scalable to tens of thousands concurrent streams, and that is deployable in live production environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and implementation of a softwarized network telemetry middle box for real time video classification, with the goal of providing network operators with a scalable and cost effective solution for monitoring video traffic.
the design of an efficient and scalable system for real time monitoring of video traffic in enterprise and carrier networks.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of a software defined network (SDN) middle box for video telemetry and classification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have designed a system that provides a new level of network visibility and control to network operators.
this paper proposes a software middle box solution that is intelligent and accurate, and can be used by network operators for monitoring and managing video streaming performance in their networks.
our system is able to provide real time, accurate, fine-grained, and scalable network traffic monitoring at very low cost.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first softwarized network monitoring solution that is able to provide real time visibility of the video streaming traffic traversing enterprise and carrier networks.
iTeleScope is the first software defined network (SDN) middle box for network traffic monitoring and classification.
we have designed and built a system that is intelligent, inexpensive and scalable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
softwarized network elements can be used for real time network traffic monitoring and analytics.
softwarized middleboxes, built on commodity hardware and open source software, can provide high accuracy, scalable, and cost-effective solutions to network monitoring and control.
software-defined networking (SDN) and machine learning can be combined to create a scalable and cost effective solution for real time network monitoring.
